label: AML screening
definition: the process of monitoring customer transactions and behaviour to detect and report activities that may constitute money laundering or the financing of terrorism, as required by applicable anti-money laundering regulations.

label: Collateral
definition: an asset pledged by a borrower to a lender as security against a loan obligation, allowing the lender to seize the asset in the event of default.

label: Credit score
definition: a numerical rating assigned to a borrower based on their credit history, repayment behaviour, and financial profile, used by lenders to evaluate the likelihood of loan repayment.

label: KYC verification process
definition: the mandatory regulatory procedure that requires the bank to verify the identity and risk profile of each customer before establishing a banking relationship or processing high-value transactions.

label: Loan-to-Value ratio
definition: the financial metric that expresses the ratio of the outstanding loan amount to the appraised market value of the collateral property, used by lenders to assess credit risk before approving a mortgage application.

label: Mortgage
definition: a loan secured by real property in which the borrower pledges the asset as collateral to the lender until the loan is fully repaid.

label: Net interest margin
definition: Net interest margin is the difference between the interest income generated by a bank and the interest paid to depositors, expressed as a percentage of interest-earning assets.

label: Overdraft
definition: a credit facility provided by a bank that allows an account holder to withdraw funds beyond the available account balance up to a pre-agreed limit, subject to interest charges on the overdrawn amount.

label: SEPA transfer
definition: a euro-denominated payment transaction executed within the Single Euro Payments Area, subject to standardised processing times and fee structures established by the European Payments Council.

label: SWIFT message
definition: a standardised financial communication sent through the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication network to facilitate cross-border payment instructions between correspondent banks.
